# Data Contract Template (DCS v2.3.0)

## Reference

Data Contract Specification v2.3.0 — https://datacontract.com

## Canonical YAML Template

Every contract generated by `contract-generator` MUST conform to this structure. Do not omit required fields. Placeholder values are shown in `<angle brackets>`.

```yaml
dataContractSpecification: "2.3.0"

id: <uuid-v4>
info:
  title: <Human-readable contract title>
  version: "1.0.0"
  status: draft  # draft | active | deprecated | retired
  description: <One-sentence description of what data this contract covers>
  owner: <producer team name>
  contact:
    name: <producer on-call contact name>
    email: <producer contact email>
    channel: <Slack channel or ticketing URL>

servers:
  production:
    type: <bigquery | snowflake | redshift | postgres | s3 | kafka>
    environment: production
    dataset: <database.schema or project.dataset>
    table: <table or view name>

terms:
  usage: <Permitted use cases for this data>
  limitations: <Any restrictions on use>
  billing: <Cost model if applicable, else "n/a">
  noticePeriod: <Notice required before schema change, e.g. "P30D" (ISO 8601 duration)>
  retention: <Data retention period, e.g. "P2Y" (ISO 8601 duration)>

schema:
  type: table  # table | object | record
  fields:
    - name: <column_name>
      type: <string | integer | long | float | double | boolean | date | timestamp | bytes | array | record>
      required: <true | false>
      primaryKey: <true | false>
      pii: <true | false>
      classification: <public | internal | confidential | restricted>
      description: <Column description>
      # Add for enum columns:
      # enum: ["value1", "value2"]
      # Add for nested records:
      # fields: []

quality:
  type: SodaCL  # SodaCL | MonteCarlo | custom
  specification:
    checks for <table_name>:
      - row_count > 0
      - freshness(<timestamp_column>) < <N>h
      - missing_count(<primary_key_column>) = 0
      - duplicate_count(<primary_key_column>) = 0
      # Add value range checks per numeric column

links:
  schema: <URL to canonical schema documentation>
  pipeline: <URL to pipeline documentation or DAG>
  slack: <URL to team Slack channel>

consumers:
  - name: <consumer team name>
    purpose: <How the consumer uses this data>
    contact:
      name: <consumer contact name>
      email: <consumer contact email>
```

## Required Fields

The following fields are REQUIRED — a contract is invalid without them:

- `dataContractSpecification`
- `id` (UUID v4)
- `info.title`
- `info.version`
- `info.status`
- `info.owner`
- `info.contact.email`
- `schema.fields` (at least one field)
- Every field entry: `name`, `type`, `required`
- `quality` block (at least row_count and freshness checks)
- `terms.retention`
- `consumers` (at least one consumer)

## PII Classification Values

| Classification | When to use |
|---|---|
| `public` | Non-sensitive, publicly accessible data |
| `internal` | Internal use only, not for external sharing |
| `confidential` | Sensitive business or operational data |
| `restricted` | PII, health data, financial data, regulated data |

## Companion Markdown Summary Template

Every YAML contract is accompanied by a human-readable Markdown file at `docs/contracts/[slug].md`:

```markdown
# Data Contract: <title>

**Version:** <version>
**Status:** <status>
**Owner:** <owner team>
**Last updated:** <date>

## What this contract covers

<description>

## Schema

| Column | Type | Required | PII | Classification | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <name> | <type> | <yes/no> | <yes/no> | <classification> | <description> |

## Quality Commitments

- Row count: > 0 at all times
- Freshness: data no older than <N> hours
- Primary key: zero nulls, zero duplicates

## Terms

- **Retention:** <retention period>
- **Usage:** <permitted uses>
- **Notice period for schema changes:** <notice period>

## Contacts

**Producer:** <producer name> — <producer email> — <channel>
**Consumer(s):** <consumer name> — <consumer email>

## Change history

| Date | Version | Change |
|---|---|---|
| <date> | 1.0.0 | Initial draft |
```

## Validation Rules

Before presenting a draft for user confirmation, `contract-generator` MUST verify:

1. All required fields are present and non-empty
2. `id` is a valid UUID v4 (format: `xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx`)
3. `schema.fields` contains only columns that actually exist in the target table — no invented columns
4. Every column with `pii: true` has `classification: restricted`
5. The `quality` block references column names that exist in `schema.fields`
6. `terms.retention` and `terms.noticePeriod` use ISO 8601 duration format

## DO NOT Rules

- DO NOT generate a contract without reading the actual schema first
- DO NOT invent column names — every field in the contract must come from the actual schema
- DO NOT omit the quality block — a contract without quality commitments is incomplete
- DO NOT write the contract without user confirmation
